2.10.1.title: A document is never accepted without its journal entry
items: Renumbering an account the software posts to — Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable and thirteen others — is refused instead of quietly breaking new documents; renaming is still yours to do
A posting that cannot find the account it needs now stops and names it, rather than saving a document that never reached the ledger
Opening a company file says once if its chart of accounts is missing an account the books depend on

2.10.0.title: The bank register is the ledger
items: A register entry posts to the general ledger, and the register shows every posting on the account with a running balance
Bank and credit-card accounts are flagged on the chart; every paid-from and deposit-to picker lists exactly those
Statement lines from feeds and imports wait in To review: match them to what you entered, or add them with a category — nothing posts silently
Transfers between accounts (that is how a card gets paid); credit-card charges pick the card and can be voided
Reconciliation ticks ledger lines, starts from the prior statement, and locks what it closed
Upgrading: the old register balance is shown once — post it as an opening balance or dismiss it
PDF receipts scan on Windows and macOS with nothing to install; poppler-utils is only needed on Linux

2.9.4.title: Company logo on every document
items: The company logo prints on invoices, estimates, statements, letters, donor documents and reports, not only the analytics PDF
Import and export failures say that they failed and put the details in the server log instead of the response

2.9.3.title: SimpleFIN request pinned to the checked address
items: The bank-feed bridge request connects to the address the SSRF guard approved, closing a DNS-rebinding window; certificate checks stay on the hostname

2.9.2.title: Security: HR and payroll are admin-only; Server Edition policy, SimpleFIN on PostgreSQL, credit-card feeds
items: Server Edition: payroll, tax forms, benefits, employee bank accounts, documents and portal tokens are admin-only for every role below admin; batch and bill payments lock the invoice or bill row
Server Edition over the LAN gets the strict script policy again; only the desktop window's own loopback connection is relaxed
SimpleFIN settings save on PostgreSQL installs (the settings value column is now text)
A bank feed can target a liability account, so credit-card feeds land on the card

2.9.1.title: Post-release tidy
items: AI Insights: a stored provider key can be removed (Remove beside the saved mark; the API clears on an explicit empty string)
Windows releases ship SHA256SUMS.windows beside the installer and zip
Nonprofit mode: the Contributions by Donor card and the analytics aging header speak donor, not sales and customer
Migrations create every table on their own; the install guide's counts are current

2.9.0.title: Nonprofit mode
items: Company Type → Nonprofit: donors, pledges, donations, funds and grants on every screen; the data never changes name
Funds with donor restrictions, a Release from Restriction document, Statement of Activities and Statement of Financial Position, fund balances
Program / management / fundraising on every expense, allocation rules with Split and month-end runs, Statement of Functional Expenses (Form 990 Part IX)
Donation receipts and acknowledgment letters with the IRS language; in-kind gifts; year-end giving statements
Pledge report over recurring pledges; write-offs to Bad Debt Expense; credit memos can be voided
P&L by Class groups on the line's class; voids carry every dimension
Save PDF lands in Documents → SlowBooks Pro → Reports and says so; saved reports are a compact list; statements compare to the prior year
Agents: unknown request fields are rejected (422), tax_rate is documented as a fraction and bounded, DELETE on a posted document names the void route, PTO enums in the spec
Desktop: Save PDF explains a refused Documents folder and says where the file went; macOS app stapled before the DMG; a fresh company can run depreciation

macOS: Save PDF, print preview, Save backup and Show in folder work again (the desktop bridge was blocked by the app's security policy since 2.1.0); Save CSV lands next to Save PDF with a Show-in-folder notice
First-run setup on a file that already has books names the company and prefills it; the company name in Settings and the picker can no longer disagree
AI Insights: a Custom (OpenAI-compatible) provider for any endpoint you name; the self-hosted Cloudflare Worker gateway's replies come through again

2.8.0.title: Benefits, all-state payroll, and an overview you can arrange
items: Benefits engine: benefit codes with rules, effective-dated rates, employer matching, employee groups, per-code GL and remittance bills
State withholding for all 50 states + DC with verified 2026 figures; state W-4 fields on the employee
PTO banks carry dollars and post a liability; actual payroll burden can flow to jobs by hours
Company Snapshot: pick, hide and reorder the cards per user, with five new cards
Sales tax per line: untaxed labor and taxed parts on one invoice
IIF and CSV export now carry classes, jobs, bills, deposits and sales receipts (#70)
Accessibility pass: real dialogs, table headers, contrast, tagged PDFs
Employee portal link opens in the employee's browser with a full address

2.7.0.title: Jobs, job costing, and receipt intake
items: Jobs under customers with cost codes, budgets and a drill-down cost tree
Job Cost Entry, time-to-job labor at loaded rates, allocations
Receipt intake: scan a receipt into a bill or expense
